title: NFT Metadata Validator
description: Validates NFT metadata JSON against the ERC-721/ERC-1155 standard and the OpenSea metadata schema. Checks required fields (name, description, image), recommended fields (external_url, animation_url, attributes array structure), and optional license fields. Returns a pass/warn/fail verdict with per-field check results. Runs entirely client-side.
